data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=GJWgiOgeY3EQ7kNvgHMJHt3&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCl9UXTzBw95W9URhxNyhaSadMh4nQo8ykxhzPkCfbE1A&oe=6713989C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=CY5cfFg-AX8Q7kNvgG202Vw&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB-S-mF-kJ0UJEr1Joflc4LiLRGK-r5r3MB7kxW5nHIHA&oe=6713A224)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=mJxqyUoQkkYQ7kNvgFRrgup&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCM-IF0obmz9-YMnhNzLGMN0obkdaa8IQ3S7tZbmO-4UQ&oe=67138987)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=-4Yz_ibvxVEQ7kNvgEqPSw3&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDN9VblqttWrrzrE_PSQrPnA8pqIQ0elpYzU8I3qC4EqA&oe=67137C66)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=19NwlN3oPgYQ7kNvgHZwgzF&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCv2HR2zWZM5jNb4JM826-UTI7JTq2K83hhwGoLojaRHA&oe=6713A8D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=EjDVxvsu07UQ7kNvgF6BncR&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAlUO593xbYZhqcKZv-vdlngsrV6PfkiPO5N4XVWn_u_A&oe=6713A559)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=33AEMRswoy4Q7kNvgE1wbI4&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD4c6kL8LP9CHzfZCziPnELJh0jexqgBc4CpLF6g80evQ&oe=67138B70)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_BFcdTED0BUQ7kNvgGruuDi&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCt6IrZCfdP1MNh_LH8-ZBRJ-iYKBLFnQhZ07PPKYpBvA&oe=6713AE2A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Te90E5j4Sk8Q7kNvgFtkVaA&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAebkS25K88Te4UN8Q_zO-fPbu7xCa_eJnheyOcThlwuw&oe=67138997)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=lwmdBRRgga8Q7kNvgFSumNO&_nc_ht=scontent-cdg4-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAGG_jvjAFI7AixUYGVNj0Sx-ZP-nasOLyCQiPbrJB9DA&oe=6713A50C)
